event_definitions.first_root_lift: Victim root y exceeds its initial value by >0.01 m during this attack/carry.
event_definitions.first_both_feet_unplanted_after_support: Both victim foot centers exceed 0.06 m after an observed supporting foot, during attack/carry.
event_definitions.land: Victim state air -> down; an engine state event, not articulated contact.
event_definitions.recovered: Victim state getup -> idle; readiness state, not verified balance.

cases.bend_definition: Local joint offset sign along cross(root-to-end, local +Z). Near-collinear or undefined reference is indeterminate. Sign is not an anatomical flexion/extension certificate; reference singularities can create sign changes.

grip.definition: Fixed thrower hr to victim pelvis center; shipped back/lunge early-carry pelvic-grip geometry proxy, not sleeve contact or a physical constraint.
grip.window: first T attack (or carry) through first carry-to-air release, inclusive

support.definition: Pelvis projection and foot-center support segment/point, not COM or a support polygon. No mass, foot shape, pressure or force measurement.

clearance.definition: Signed skeleton joint-center clearance and nominal-radius presentation proxies; no real ground collider. Straight segment minimum y equals its lower endpoint; screen-space Bezier legs/variable depth widths do not exactly match this skeleton proxy.
clearance.crossing_time_uncertainty: Bracketed by adjacent retained simulation samples; fractions assume linear interpolation and do not prove contact order within a frame.

rebound.definition: From landing reference until first getup/recovered state; stored root vy and pose displacement are distinct. No restitution, impulse, energy or physical rebound certification.

unavailable: true center of mass and mass distribution
limitations: Original trace remains authoritative; this summary never calls pose or modifies gameplay.
Dynamic samples exclude duplicate engine ticks and repeated hitstop simulation ticks; render-only changes during those samples are not included.
Geometry distributions describe recorded conditions, not population biomechanics; four style/facing cases are not statistical replication.
Exact shoulder/hip construction matches recorded drawF conventions; missing coordinates reduce counts and must be inspected.
Stored root velocity can differ from finite-difference rendered pose motion; pose jumps are not impulses.
No empirical acceptance thresholds are claimed. Grip thresholds and nominal radii are explicit diagnostic assumptions.
Joint step distances span adjacent retained samples; simulation gaps are counted and must be considered.
A fixture selecting Blue style in slot 0 is not native Blue slot-1 execution-order coverage.
